title: Anna and the Bus
text:
Anna has a city map. The map shows the bus station and the park. The bus station is next to the park. Anna goes to the park by bus at nine o'clock.

The bus timetable is on the wall. The bus leaves every twenty minutes. The last bus leaves at half past ten in the evening. Anna always checks the timetable before she goes out.

questions.text: Why does Anna check the timetable before she goes out?
options: She wants to know when the bus leaves.
She wants to buy a new map.
She wants to walk to the park.
She wants to visit the station.

questions.text: Why might Anna miss the last bus?
options: She arrives after half past ten.
She checks the timetable at nine.

vocabulary.definition: a list that shows when buses or trains leave and arrive
a place where buses or trains stop so people can get on and off
a drawing that shows the roads and places in a city
goes away from a place at a certain time

paragraph_translations: Anna ma mapę miasta. Mapa pokazuje dworzec autobusowy i park. Dworzec autobusowy jest obok parku. Anna jedzie autobusem do parku o dziewiątej.
Rozkład jazdy autobusów wisi na ścianie. Autobus odjeżdża co dwadzieścia minut. Ostatni autobus odjeżdża o wpół do jedenastej wieczorem. Anna zawsze sprawdza rozkład przed wyjściem.
